svg.title: Bagholder & Sons share certificate
svg.desc: A joke share certificate of BAGHOLDER & SONS, printed in one ink with a red wax seal. The vignette shows a pile of bags: a tied sack, a strapped suitcase with a carpet bag on top, and a small doctor's bag. Under the name it says THIS CERTIFIES NOTHING, and a sheet of five numbered coupons hangs below a perforation.
